steps.what: Retrieve and check the approved jewelry pattern, dimensions and material requirements from the workshop's existing job library
inputs: Existing approved jewelry pattern and job requirements

steps.what: Create the jewelry by preparing, forming, joining, setting and finishing its actual metals and stones
Inspect fit, stone security and finish and correct workmanship defects

tasks.design: Configure retrieval by job and pattern in the existing {DOCS} library. Physical jewelry creation and inspection remain with the jeweler; no new machine fabrication or report is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The correct pattern and material requirements can take repeated searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document metadata and saved job views can improve retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Precise forming, stone setting, joining and surface finishing.
tasks.human_edge: The jeweler adjusts technique to the actual materials and workmanship.

ambition.what: Reduce pattern retrieval effort within the existing workshop process.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document libraries can retrieve existing job patterns by metadata; physical jewelry fabrication remains skilled bench work.

assumptions: This scenario uses an existing approved pattern and job library; original design work is not silently generated for free.
The pattern author already supplies dimensions and requirements; s1 verifies version and suitability. Missing information returns to the job owner.
No required record or send is established for this bench-creation task. Any actual workshop traceability entry must be measured separately rather than invented here.
Illustrative gross saving 3 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 2; existing machine runtime and handwork have no new saving.
unknowns: Actual pattern retrieval effort and whether this workshop has required traceability recording
research_questions: Is the approved pattern already one click from the work order?

already_counted.description: Check the retrieved pattern and requirements

incremental.description: Maintain pattern metadata and current-version links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured existing-pattern scenario; only reduced retrieval effort after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate labor and material production costs

steps.what: Capture and verify actual or explicitly estimated material weights, stone quantities, labor time and applicable price and labor-rate sources
inputs: Jeweler's measured weights and time records or labeled estimates
Supplier price records and workshop-approved labor rates
outputs: Checked costing inputs with units, dates and actual-versus-estimate labels

steps.what: Match checked material identifiers and units to the workshop costing sheet's approved price and rate table
outputs: Mapped cost lines and unmatched-item exceptions

steps.what: Compute labor and material production costs using the approved costing formulas and mapped lines
inputs: Approved costing rules including applicable waste or recovery treatment
outputs: Calculated draft production-cost sheet with exceptions

steps.what: Resolve unmatched items and check every cost line, units, price dates, labor basis and totals against the source records
inputs: Original measurement, time, price and rate sources

steps.what: Save the final checked cost sheet in its existing workbook

tasks.design: Configure exact item mapping and approved formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, using checked measurements and price records from {PROCUREMENT}. Input capture, exception resolution and source checks remain explicit; the calculation produces a draft before the jeweler checks and saves the final cost sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item matching, unit conversion and manual construction of cost calculations can be avoidable work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing spreadsheet tables and formulas can perform exact mappings and arithmetic without a language model.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable labor estimates, material recovery treatment, changing prices and exceptional stones.
tasks.human_edge: The jeweler judges whether measurements and labor assumptions represent the actual piece.

ambition.what: Recalculate a piece when checked material prices or labor assumptions change, using the same approved rules.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; workshop and purchasing owners approve price and rate access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet lookup tables and formulas can compute production costs from checked quantities, prices and labor rates.

assumptions: The jeweler captures measurements and time or labeled estimates in s1; purchasing supplies existing price records and the workshop supplies approved labor rates. Missing identifiers, rates or units stop affected lines.
s2 and s3 replace currently manual item matching and repeated costing-sheet construction. Arithmetic or mappings already automated in today's workbook earn no additional gain.
The workshop's actual costing policy is supplied and checked, not invented by a model; estimates remain labeled.
Illustrative gross saving 45 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 41. Same-workbook saving has no gain and no customer quote or purchase is sent.
unknowns: Current spreadsheet automation and actual effort on item matching and calculation setup
research_questions: Which repeated costing operations are manual today, and how are scrap and recoverable metal treated?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify inputs and resolve and check every costing line

incremental.description: Maintain approved item mappings, unit rules and costing formulas

approvals.approved_version: Final cost sheet checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario with manual matching and repeated calculation setup today; capture and complete source checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Grade stones for color, perfection and cut quality

steps.what: Retrieve and check the applicable grading criteria and reference descriptions for this stone type
Examine the actual stone under the appropriate controlled viewing conditions and grade color, perfection and quality of cut
inputs: Existing grading instruments and reference stones where used

steps.what: Enter and check the actual grade and observations in the stone-linked inventory record
Save the checked grade in the same stone inventory system

tasks.design: Use the existing grading-reference index in {DOCS} and stone-linked fields in the jewelry inventory {OPS_SYSTEM}. Actual examination and grading remain expert work; the form only reduces repeated identity entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference retrieval and repeating stone identity in grading records can add handling effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document search and linked inventory forms can reduce that handling.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle color and inclusion judgments, viewing conditions and cut quality.
tasks.human_edge: The jeweler examines the actual stone and interprets its characteristics.

ambition.what: Reduce reference and recording effort without asserting automatic stone grading.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory systems can link grade observations to stone identifiers; document indexes can retrieve reference criteria.

assumptions: The workshop already records grades against identified stones; the jeweler captures actual observations in s3, with no free camera feed or model-produced grade.
Use existing reference and inventory functions first; no new certificate or customer send is included.
Illustrative gross saving 3.9 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 2.9; same-system save earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual reference retrieval and grade-recording effort
research_questions: Does the existing stone record already carry identity and grading-reference fields?

already_counted.description: Check criteria and capture and check actual grade observations

incremental.description: Maintain reference links and grading fields

approvals.approved_version: Final grade record checked in s3; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured existing-inventory workflow; only retrieval and repeated identity entry reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and acquire metals and gems

steps.what: Retrieve current stock and supplier catalogue entries for the actual jewelry design requirements
inputs: Existing stock records and supplier catalogue entries
outputs: Candidate stock and supplier items with current source details

steps.what: Select suitable metals and gems by inspecting actual available materials or supplier specifications against the design
Prepare the supplier order from selected catalogue lines, entering actual quantities and required delivery details
inputs: Selected materials and quantities from s2

steps.what: Check the final supplier order's identities, specifications, quantities, prices, delivery, recipient and purchasing authority
outputs: Final checked supplier order within authority

steps.what: Send the final checked order to the selected supplier through the existing procurement channel
inputs: Final checked supplier order and recipient

steps.what: Receive the actual metals and gems and inspect identity, quantity, condition and suitability against the order
outputs: Inspected received materials and actual discrepancies

steps.what: Enter and check actual received material identities, quantities and discrepancies in the inventory receipt record
Save the final checked receipt in the same inventory system

tasks.design: Configure stock and catalogue retrieval in {OPS_SYSTEM} and existing supplier-line order forms in {PROCUREMENT}. The jeweler selects materials and checks the complete order before a separate gated supplier send; actual receipt inspection and inventory recording remain counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock searches and repeating supplier item fields can consume purchasing preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue and procurement forms can reuse supplier item details without choosing stones automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Material suitability, stone appearance, supplier reliability and availability.
tasks.human_edge: The jeweler matches actual material qualities to the intended design.

ambition.what: Reduce purchasing preparation within existing material-selection and authority rules.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; stock and procurement owners confirm supplier data and delegated purchasing authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement catalogues can reuse supplier item fields in draft orders while leaving material selection and order checks with a person.

assumptions: This is an acquisition episode where the jeweler already has delegated authority; orders outside that authority stop for the actual purchasing approver before sending.
Stock staff and suppliers maintain existing records; s1 checks current sources and s3 captures selected quantities and delivery needs. Missing prices or identifiers require manual resolution.
The proposed mechanism reduces repeated fields, not actual material inspection. Existing catalogue reuse already present earns no new saving.
Illustrative gross saving 11.7 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2, net 9.7. The actual send remains fully counted and has no click-saving claim.
The acquisition includes actual receipt inspection, manual capture and checking of received materials and a separate same-system inventory save, all fully retained.
unknowns: Actual delegated authority, catalogue coverage and receiving responsibilities
research_questions: Which order fields are retyped today despite existing supplier catalogue identifiers?

already_counted.description: Check catalogue sources, enter actual order needs and check the final order

incremental.description: Maintain stock and supplier field mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final supplier order and recipient checked in s4; changes require rechecking
Final inventory receipt checked in s7; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured authorized-order episode; only retrieval and repeated order fields reduced, net of upkeep.

Use linked inventory and purchasing forms
